snapshot.current: Root-frozen first repair batch, identified by the current file hashes below.
snapshot.isolation: Classification context contains the initial classifier's own reading and record. Author explanations, author records, evidence HTML and other reviewers' records were not opened.
snapshot.authority: Current Scripts construction instruction; current selected contracts. Initial verdicts remain attributable to their original baseline contract inputs.

coverage.scope: All changed lines and their unified-five-line current context from the 20 manuscript diffs were read, plus the expressly listed complete current dependent units. This is not a new whole-body pass.

method.four_parent_tests: Copied wording/imagery, explanatory labels, narrator/design statements, borrowed opening/action sequence. Dash is no identified candidate; Y is yes. A run comparison can fail without declaring each short utterance intrinsically copied.
method.segmentation: Same reproducible locator convention as the initial record; protected a.m./p.m. and common title abbreviations, terminal punctuation followed by an uppercase/quote start, caption fragments retained. Original source line/character spans are authoritative.
method.changed_scope: Diff hunks define inspected ranges; blank/heading/parent-link lines have structural rows. Eight complete current dependent units were reread separately. No unchanged ambiguous judgment was reopened for preference alone.
method.recheck_rule: Every new yes is supported by a clear current failure or by a changed neighboring passage that creates a new failure. In particular, R1-05 and R1-06 reopen unchanged sentences only because the actual neighboring speech changed. A previously failed passage is not failed again on unresolved taste.
method.no_invention_requirement: No new event, conflict, legal provision, historical claim or sensory ornament is demanded to avoid a form. Necessary staging, source boundaries, short complete words, canonical appearance and adopted narrator functions remain permitted.
method.parent_comparison: Current scripts and actual treatment passages were compared separately from expression. Unchanged treatment bodies retain their initial full-reading provenance, with current hashes checked; the specifically reread treatment H2s are listed below. No source link is treated as proof of media experience.
method.baseline_table: The initial 3,571-row table was not regenerated or altered. Identical reread sentence text links to its old locator; uninspected old rows are not called freshly read.
method.value_audit: All 12 initial unresolved-value groups were checked at their actual active canon owners and, where necessary, the directly adopted source performance paragraphs. An absent repeated value in immediate prose was not automatically called a factual invention or missing handoff.

tested_failures.C18: physical limits reduced to names or numbers
tested_failures.S04: neighboring action repeated in another register
tested_failures.S08: reply meaning shifted while preserving words
tested_failures.R04: summary substituted for exchange or intervening execution
tested_failures.R08: inconsistent audiovisual staging or knowledge access
tested_failures.A01: habitual opening, explanation, montage, music, reaction pause or closing imposed on different material
tested_failures.A03: weight lost to uniform short beats
tested_failures.U01: copied planning labels or explanatory categories
tested_failures.U05: shot list without finished audiovisual relation

tested_failures.N01: promised essential operation or result absent

findings.quote: A French soldier loads amid gunfire.
findings.rangeEnd: Their breathing gives way to work in the occupied territory.
parentPassages: From behind French infantry, see musket smoke and the opposing troops beyond it. Firing continues as men reload.
When the smoke opens again, the opposing troops are withdrawing. The French advance over the ground left clear, then halt together. Men lower their muskets and catch their breath.
findings.reason: The newly added screenplay imports the new script's chosen loading/smoke opening/enemy withdrawal/French occupation/lowered muskets/breathing sequence. The treatment fixes the land victory, not this particular realization.
findings.exception: The land victory and concise basic connections must remain. The multi-beat smoke and bodily sequence is not a short artifact or an unavoidable statement of that result; the added work transition does not excuse its copied realization.

findings.quote: Cambacérès sits between Napoleon and the jurist's draft.
findings.rangeEnd: The completed code closes on the table.
parentPassages: JURIST: These restrictions remain in the same code?
CAMBACÉRÈS: We must settle them together, Citizen First Consul.
NAPOLEON: Does that change remove the restrictions?
JURIST: No. It states them explicitly.
findings.reason: The replacement follows the script's same selected progression: approve equality/property, raise family restrictions, require coordinated wording, read a correction, reconfirm restrictions, continue deliberation and close. The hear-before-see opening and reworded short replies do not recreate the rest of this execution sequence.
findings.exception: Legal terms and already complete short utterances may be preserved. This finding concerns the complete chosen exchange/action run, not a demand to invent another legal provision or conflict.

findings.quote: Elsewhere in Spain, a French escort stops its supply cart when armed figures block the road ahead.
findings.rangeEnd: At Cádiz the public political space remains distant, with indistinct meeting sounds.
parentPassages: Armed figures appear across the way. The French escort halts and takes cover beside the cart; the load cannot continue.
findings.reason: The new paragraph repeats the script's particular armed roadblock/escort shelter beside its load/cart unable to continue operation. The treatment owns continuing guerrilla resistance, not this invented cart encounter.
findings.exception: The geographical separation and ongoing resistance are inherited. The ship-sound relation added next is new, but neighboring creativity cannot exempt this borrowed encounter sequence.

findings.quote: France, 1814. Begin within the small French force, where men under fire look back toward approaching troops.
findings.rangeEnd: The sound of their last victory recedes from this empty direction; the Allied road toward Paris remains open beyond them.
parentPassages: Troops arriving beside Napoleon move toward the pressured position at his signal. The new ranks join those still firing; guns brought up behind them open fire. The enemy before them withdraws.
Napoleon watches the withdrawal, then turns to the next demand. He points down another road.
From farther away, see their departure and the other approach they cannot fill at the same time. Hold the empty approach while their footsteps recede.
findings.reason: The expanded screenplay follows the new script's relief ranks/guns/enemy withdrawal/next demand/next road/departure/empty approach sequence. These are newly chosen script execution beats, not only the treatment's general victory and limited defense result.
findings.exception: A short factual bridge may remain. This multi-paragraph action and exit sequence, including the receding movement at the empty approach, exceeds that exception.

findings.quote: Reading news arriving on the island, Napoleon looks down at paper and speaks.
parentPassages: Napoleon, unable to summon family at will, reads discontent about the French Restoration.
findings.reason: The actual line removed for Q22 leaves its adjacent instruction that Napoleon speaks. What follows is a screen summary and paper handling, with no words or intentionally indistinct speech assigned to him.
findings.exception: Useful speech and sound instructions are protected; this residual instruction no longer has an audible realization. Removing the dangling instruction does not require new dialogue.

findings.quote: The government's order and the place the Church sought to defend were not the same.
parentPassages: For Napoleon reconciliation is an order that cannot be obtained by erasing all faith; for believers it offers a way to continue a life interrupted by revolution.
Preserve reconciliation as one real cause of support, and also the state's authority to control religion.
findings.reason: The newly expanded adjacent exchange now performs this same distinction through Napoleon's need to govern and Cambacérès's Church/army objection and demand for each side's place. The unchanged second narrator sentence has thereby become a duplicate of its new neighboring scene.
findings.exception: The first sentence's date, Concordat identification and reconciliation context remain useful. Adopted narration is protected when it adds unavailable judgment, irony, cost or anticipation; the second sentence now merely previews what the exchange performs.

findings.quote: Keep the weaver's working hands in the foreground as the visitors move on.
parentPassages: The visit ends with both sides present.
findings.reason: The new closing run explicitly continues beyond the visitors' departure before closing the visit, changing the parent-fixed exit state. The original copied closing sequence is removed, but this replacement introduces a separate fidelity loss.
findings.exception: Unresolved employment and useful camera/sound choices remain. They do not authorize silently changing the treatment's specified exit state; a construction change to that state belongs to its owner.
additional_affected_quotes: Stay with that work beyond their departure, then close the visit.

findings.quote: A separate corps then counterattacks, but cannot rally the defeated troops.
parentPassages: A separate corps then counterattacks but cannot reverse the defeat already inflicted.
findings.reason: The idiom repair changes an unsuccessful counterattack's battle outcome into a failed rallying of defeated troops. A downstream author can now stage a different troop recovery process not supplied by the parent.
findings.exception: Wording, emphasis and short necessary connections may change. A failed effort or inability to rally troops is a distinct result from failing to reverse a defeat, so this is more than a stylistic synonym.

preserved_after_recheck: The sword taunt and insulting retort preserve the adopted historical speech acts without a duel or reconciliation.
The rewritten Duroc passage's outside audience position and paper/chair/access cues were not failed again merely because clarification and admission remain necessary.
The new childcare passage preserves parental joy and recovery through the mother's resting attention without requiring another event.
Ney's spoken comparison with his 1814 decision gives a current motive to the waiting officer; recollection alone is not redundant explanation.
Grouchy's instructions about what he has received are useful access boundaries, not forbidden technical language.
Anonymous loading, marching, training and resistance staging was not treated as a new historical event merely because it adds performable action.
World terms, complete short replies, actual titles, useful camera/sound notation, narrator history, institutional documentary captions and the existing picture joke were not banned as forms.
limits: Only changed passages, read neighbors, and listed dependencies are reclassified. This is not a full closing review or independent approval.
The initial record's full value inventory limitation is not silently erased: this recheck resolves its named 12 groups and new changed values, not every possible unchanged world value.
Negative paragraph mappings remain actual parent-H2-set comparisons, with exact positive passages supplied for each new finding.
Unchanged parents were hash-confirmed against their prior full reading; a hash comparison is not itself a new reading.
No performed speech, render, soundtrack, timing or assembled media was observed.
Referenced source appearances are adopted fictional performance choices where their owners say so, not freshly authenticated historical portraits.
